name: M'ONDUNIQ SeboBalance Pro ampoule
shortDescription: Professional active-ingredient cocktail for the targeted treatment of oily, acne-prone, seborrhoeic and inflammation-prone skin: Acnacidol BG, arginine, allantoin and SyriCalm™. 10 × 3 ml sterile professional ampoules.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ SeboBalance Pro Ampoule is a highly effective professional active-ingredient cocktail developed for the targeted treatment of oily, acne-prone, seborrhoeic and inflammation-prone skin. Its modern formula does not just focus on the visible symptoms of problematic skin but also supports the restoration of the skin's natural balance, resulting in a healthier, clearer and more comfortable complexion over the long term.

The combined action of Acnacidol BG, arginine, allantoin and SyriCalm™ helps regulate excess sebum production and reduce redness and irritation, while supporting skin regeneration and strengthening its natural defences. The concentrate is an ideal choice during professional facial treatments, as a standalone treatment or as part of complex acne treatment protocols.

The light, fast-absorbing formula combines excellently with modern aesthetic technologies, helping treatments be effective without weighing down or irritating the skin.
